title: Buttons
intro: HeroUI Button with Takere colors. One primary action per area; the rest use more subtle variants.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Six variants, from most to least emphatic.

tertiary.label: Cancel
tertiary.usage: Supporting actions and icon buttons in cards.

icons.title: With icon
icons.description: Icon to the left of the label. Icon-only buttons need an aria-label.

states.title: States
states.description: Show progress during async operations, and disable only when the action is truly unavailable.

guidelines.do1: Use imperative verbs: Save, Send, Create plan.
guidelines.do2: On mobile, stack buttons and place the primary action last (closest to the thumb).
guidelines.do3: Confirm destructive actions in a dialog.
guidelines.dont1: Don't place two primary actions side by side.
guidelines.dont2: Don't use danger for reversible actions.
guidelines.dont3: Don't use generic labels like OK or Click here.
